programs.title: Creek To Coast
programs.desc: Creek to Coast is all things boating, camping, 4WDing, outdoor adventuring and fishing. From bush-bashing to cooking to caravanning to watersports, Creek to Coast has it all.

programs.title: Mighty Ships
programs.desc: FPSO Maersk Peregrino is the most expensive single project in Maersk history; she is the world's biggest oil production ship and will be permanently hooked up at the Peregrino oilfield off the coast of Rio de Janeiro.

programs.title: Swamp People: Serpent Invasion
programs.desc: Troy and Pickle help rid a citrus grove of pythons. Bill is forced to hunt solo for the day. Meanwhile, Brue and Zak mount an airboat to a new honey hole and Dusty responds to a friend's call for help.

programs.title: Australia ReDiscovered
programs.desc: Join Ricko as he follows in the tracks of an iconic outback train journey before revealing a mystery carved in stone near Sydney, then finally telling the story of our most influential astronomer.

programs.title: American Restoration
programs.desc: Rick wagers a high-stakes bet when a battered 1970s Harley-Davidson Golf Cart comes in. The shop also tries to restore a 1950s toy horse pedal cart.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Back in Montebello, Brandi and her buddy set the wayback machine and discover a roaring good time. Darrell makes the most of the little he's got. And Kenny fills his piggy bank, while courting an unfamiliar pastime.
